 ***Open the door for global talent – specialist immigration expertise that brings the world's best minds to Macquarie***

  

Every year, academics, researchers, clinicians and professional staff from around the world choose to build their careers at Macquarie University. Behind each of those arrivals sits a visa pathway to navigate, a nomination to lodge, a family to settle and a compliance obligation to meet. This is where you come in.

  

As our Visa, Relocation and Global Mobility Specialist, you will be the University's subject matter expert on immigration and mobility. You will advise hiring managers, faculty leadership and candidates on visa options and eligibility, manage the end\-to\-end visa lifecycle for international academics and researchers, and coordinate relocation arrangements that help new starters and their families settle in quickly. You will also safeguard the University's compliance position, maintaining sponsorship records, monitoring visa expiries and keeping us audit\-ready.

  

Sitting within the Talent Acquisition team in Human Resources, this is a rare specialist role in a complex, highly regulated environment where your advice has visible impact on individual careers, on research programs, and on Macquarie's ability to attract the best talent globally. If you enjoy untangling intricate immigration matters and translating legislation into clear, practical guidance, you will find plenty of scope here.

 **About the Role**

  

Reporting to the Head of Talent Acquisition, you will provide specialist, high\-level guidance, information, compliance oversight and reporting on immigration and relocation matters to internal stakeholders, current staff, prospective staff and international visitors.


Your responsibilities will include:

  

* Providing expert advice to hiring managers and University leaders on visa and immigration regulations, compliance and reporting
* Assessing visa eligibility, explaining visa subclasses (including 407, 408, 482 and 186\) and outlining step\-by\-step processes for existing staff, prospective employees and visiting academics
* Managing the visa lifecycle for distinguished researchers and postdoctoral fellows, including employer nomination processing and correspondence with government departments
* Applying and upholding the University's immigration policies and procedures, mitigating risk across all cases and escalating any breaches
* Maintaining mandatory sponsorship records, tracking visa expiry dates and work right compliance and ensuring readiness for federal immigration audits
* Acting as the primary contact point between the University, external legal counsel and government departments, and liaising with external agencies to resolve issues as they arise
* Coordinating international and domestic relocation benefits, housing resources and onboarding logistics for incoming staff and their families
* Delivering information sessions and training to HR colleagues and stakeholders across the organisation on immigration changes, compliance, visa sponsorship and policy adherence

 **About Us**

  

Human Resources sits within the portfolio of the Deputy Vice\-Chancellor People and Operations, delivering high\-level strategic advisory services to Macquarie University and its entities including Macquarie University Hospital and Health Clinics, and U@MQ, the University's commercial enterprise. Our HR Business Partnering teams and Centres of Expertise span Employee Relations, Talent Acquisition, Remuneration, and Capability, Culture and Inclusion, with HR Shared Services and HR Applications underpinning the portfolio.

  

The Talent Acquisition team is the specialist function responsible for attracting and acquiring domestic and international talent across the University and its entities. Our work is guided by Macquarie's values: collective ambition, purposeful collaboration, bold innovation and genuine care.

 **About You (Selection Criteria)**

  

You are an immigration and mobility specialist who reads legislation closely, keeps meticulous records and explains complex requirements in plain language. You navigate large organisations with ease, handle sensitive personal information with discretion, and find practical solutions when a case does not fit the standard pathway.

  

* Qualifications in HR, business, law or a related discipline and/or substantial relevant experience; OMARA registration desirable
* Demonstrated experience in immigration consulting, corporate mobility or global relocation, ideally within a university, large public sector institution or comparable regulated environment
* Detailed knowledge of Australian immigration legislation and visa processes, including visa subclasses 407, 408, 482 and 186, academic exemptions and pathways relevant to research and higher education
* Proven expertise in employer\-sponsored visas, nomination processing and immigration compliance, with the capability to interpret and apply migration legislation autonomously within a complex organisational context

job_title: NSW Property Student & Graduate Talent Community For Valuations
description_text:
**Join our Talent Community for Assistant Property Valuer Opportunities.**

  

By joining this community, you will be kept informed of upcoming Assistant Valuer roles across NSW. Whilst our commercial team is based in Sydney our Residential Valuers are more broadly based across the region.


We are interested in property students (as required by the API) from 2nd year upwards interested in a career in property valuations.


Please upload your cv, academic transcript (or something showing courses taken and grades achieved – this isn’t urgent but helps your application) and cover letter to let us know if you have a preference between commercial and residential valuations.

 **What’s in it for you?**

  

* Learn from the best and work towards CPV status!
* Undertake property inspections, compiling valuation data, and creating quality reports
* Join specialist divisions working across a range of commercial or residential assets across Sydney and NSW
* Training and experience that will enable your success

  

Our people benefit from a range of educational, financial, lifestyle, health and wellbeing benefits and programs, corporate partnerships/discounts, and paid volunteer days. We are a family friendly employer of choice – come and join the team!

 **Can we inspire you to join us?**


At CBRE, our unwavering commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion begins with you. We are strengthening our inclusive culture, so everyone feels safe, valued, and heard. Because when you belong, we all succeed.

  



We are proud to be certified as a Family Inclusive Workplace in Australia. This is a great recognition to our different policies, programs and benefits which help us build a great family friendly workplace culture.
